name: Open ReadSpeaker
description: Insert ReadSpeaker Enterprise Highlighting to selected node types.
project_description:
Open ReadSpeaker is an adaptation from the official module that ReadSpeaker provide.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Block Config. 
 Best Admin UX. 
 Supports Enterprise Highlighting & webReader product by ReadSpeaker.

 1.x to 2.x Migration 
 The provided update hooks in 2.0.0 updating the config objects and the block instances.

You only have to review the renamed template open-readspeaker-webreader . So if you have any overrides review and adapt the new template.
